chunks.text: The Sunken Reach is a flooded province east of the capital. Its people travel by skiff and pay tolls in salt-coin. The legion garrison at Fort Merrow keeps the drowned roads open.
Salt-coin is stamped with a heron and melts if boiled — forgery is trivially detected, so it is trusted across the coast. One coin buys a night's lodging or two loaves.
